tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhan dus ky-i 'khor lo'i spyi don bstan pa'i rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañju badz+rā ya/ phyi nang 'byung chos las snang rags pa'i khams// lam gyi thabs bsgyur phyi nang dri ma kun/ /sbyangs pas phyi nang las gzhan bden gnyis kyi/ /phyi nang dkyil 'khor ston mkhas de la 'dud/ / gsum pa gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag la smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed lam bshad pa'o/ / dang po la spyi dang bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ bdag po la dbang por bshad pa'i an+d+ra'i sgra dang*/ bsgyur bya la dbang du bshad pa wa shaṃ gi sgra las drangs nas bshad par bya ba ma yin gyi/ se ka la nye bsgyur a bhi sngon du sbyar ba a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sgra las drangs nas bshad par bya ste/ de la yang yi ge phyis bsnan byas nas/ a bhi dang ka ta phyis nas tsa dang na bsnan zhing*/ byings kyi dang po'i ṣa sa ru bsgyur bas/ se tsa na 'thor ba'am 'khru ba ste/ tha mal gyi snang zhen phra rags 'khru zhing sbyong ba'o/ /de bzhin du phyis bsnan byed tshul shes par byas nas ni ṣak+ṣa lugs su blug pa ste/ khams phal pa bzhu nas lha'i rnam par bsgyur ba'o/ /shak+ti s+tha pa ti nus pa 'jog pa ste/ sprul sku sogs sku bzhi'i nus pa 'jog wa shaṃ ka ro ka ti dbang bar byed pa ste/ rim gnyis bsgom pa dang*/ dam tshig rnams bsrung ba la dbang*/ kat+ya pāk+ṣa ti 'bras bu mngon du byed pa ste/ sku bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa'i 'bras bu rnams dbang po so sos ji ltar 'tshams par mngon du byed do/ de yang bya ba de dang des sems la 'gyur ba khyad par ba bskyed nas sems kyi steng du thob bya khyad par can gyi nus pa gsar du 'jog pa ni dbang gi don yin la/ de yang bya spyod man chad du nus pa nyid la dbang du ngo sprod cing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud du 'khyud pa'i dang*/ bla med du thabs de las kyang gong du gyur pa las byung ba'i bde ba dngos la dbang du ngo sprod pa ste/ thams cad la smin byed rgyu'i dang*/

grol byed lam gyi dang*/ thob bya 'bras bu'i dbang rnams yod do/ /nus pa la dbang gi sgra yangs par khyer ba tsam ni 'dul ba las kyang 'byung ste/ dge tshul gyi rtags sdom ste/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal nod dbang skur yin/ /zhes so// de bzhin mdo sde'i phyogs las kyang mang du 'byung la/ khyad par sa bcu pa'i mdor| sa bcu pa'i byang sems la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang skur sbyin tshul rgyas par gsungs pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang dang rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur te 'tshang rgya tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gsungs pa rnams dang rjes su mthun par dri ma'i lhag ma dbang gis sbyangs nas thob bya don gyi dbang thob par byed pa'i thabs su shes par bya ba yin te/ yi ge mang du dwaugs pas mi spro'o/ /rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gi rim pa ni ye shes thig le sogs kyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar gong du bshad zin pa nyid do/ khyad par bla med kyi dbang bzhis sku bzhi'i nus pa 'jog pa dang*/ lam bzhi bsgom pa dang dam tshig bzhi bsrung ba la dbang ba sogs ni kun la gsal la/ bye brag tu kyai rdo rje las/ dbang bzhi la brten pa'i bzhi tshan gyi lam rim rgyas par 'byung ba dang*/ yang sgos 'di pa'i dbang bcu gcig gi nus pa gang 'jog pa dang*/ dbang gang gis lam gyi spangs rtogs ji tsam bsgrub pa ni mdor bsdus smon lam rnams su brjod zin la/ rgyas par 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ / gnyis pa la gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma/ nam gyi tshe bskur ba'i dus/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga de ltar du bskur pa'i dgos pa'o/ / dang po ni/ spyir rang rgyud theg pa thun mong bas sbyangs pa dgos shing*| gdul bya mchog dman mtha' dag rjes su gzung dgos pas/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong*/

/nang du gsang ba 'dus la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa mtha' dag tshang ba dgos pa'i phyir na/ 'dul ba'i dbang du byas na/ tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad pa snying brtse 'khor ni dag pa dang*/ /chos dang zang zing phan thogs brtson pa dang*| |dus su 'doms pa de dag bla mar bsngags/ /zhes sogs rten mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan dang*/ theg pa thun mong gi dbang du byas na/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag par brtson byas lung gi phyug |de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyong ba spangs la bsten/ /zhes sogs dang*/ theg chen gyi dbang du byas na/ byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang*/ /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /ces sogs so/ /rgyud sde gong 'og las slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid rgyas par gsungs pa rnams mkhas mchog dpa' bos bsdus te/ bla ma lnga bcu par/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang*/ /spyoms dang bcas pa mi bya'o/ /zhes sogs kyi skyon dang*/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /gsang sngags 'chad pa'i sbyor ba shes/ /rab tu dngas zhing dbang po dul/ /zhes sogs yon tan bshad pa ni/ 'grel chen 'dir yang lung du drangs pa'i dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi tshig tu mngon no/ /de la spyoms pa ni/ sems rgyud kyi yon tan dang dge ba sngar byas pa mi sbed par yang yang sgrog pa'o/ /sngags ky-i sbyor ba ni/

ming don/ spel tshig rdo rje'i tshig sgra spangs pa'o/ /rgyud kyi sbyor ba ni/ gser 'gyur dang 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal sogs so/ /de nyid bcu ni/ rong pa sher seng*/ brtan zhing dul ba sogs bgrangs kyang*/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ spyi dang*/ gsang ba'i de nyid bcu bcu bshad cing*/ rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan du/ dkyil 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin dang*/ /phyag rgya bya ba 'dug stangs dang*/ /gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas dang*/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams so/ /'di'i tshigs bcad gnyis pas yon tan dang*/ gsum pas skyon gyi mtshan nyid rnams bshad do/ /de yang yon tan ni/ dam tshig dang ldan nas/ rdo rje sems dpar grags pa'i bar bcu gnyis las/ slob ma la lam sbyin pa dang*/ dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa dang*/ bdud 'jom pa dang*/ rdor sems su grags pa rnams gzhan don dang*/ gzhan rnams rang don gtso che la| de yang ma chags pa dang dri ma bral ba gnyis spang bya spangs pa dang*/ gzhan rnams thob bya thob pa'i yon tan no/ /skyon ni nga rgyal nas/ 'dod ldan gyi bar du bcu gnyis te/ thos pa med pa dang*/ sems nyams pa dang*/ dbang ma thob pa gsum| thob bya ma thob pa dang*/ gzhan rnams dor bya ma dor ba'i skyon te/ de la yang sems kyi skyon dang*/ lus ngag gi skyon sogs su bsdu tshul dpyad nas shes par bya'o/ /de yang yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan zhing skyon mtha' dag dang bral ba ni dus kyi dbang gi rnyed par dka' bas/ yon tan shas che ba tsam la yang bsten dgos par gsungs te/ don dam bsnyen pa las/ rtsod dus dbang gis bla ma skyon dang yon tan 'dres/ /rnam pa kun tu sdig pa med pa yod ma yin| |gang zhig yon tan lhag pa yang ni legs dpyad nas/ /bu rnams kyis ni de la bsten par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang rab dge slong*| 'bring dge tshul/ tha ma khyim pa ste/

sa thob ma gtogs pa'i khyim pa la rab byung dang rgyal po sogs kyis bkur bsti mi bya ba dang*/ des kyang slob dpon gzhan gnyis sa phyogs de na yod bzhin du dbang dang rab gnas sogs rdo rje slob dpon gyi las mi bya ba sogs la nan tan cher gsungs pa ni/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la gces spras mchog tu mdzad pa ste/ don 'di la sems 'grel gsum ka na shin tu nan tan che bar mdzad pas/ rab byung spyi dang khyad par dang tshugs tshul bzhin du byed pa'i rab byung gang yin nyan thos theg dman yin zhes smra ba'i gsang sngags par rlom pa dag ni/ spyir rang 'byor lnga'i gnas la dad pa ma tshang zhing*/ khyad par rdo rje 'chang dang sa bcu'i byang sems kyi dgongs pa las rgyab kyis phyogs pa'o/ /yang ba 'di la mi mkhas pa kha cig slob dpon yon tan blang bya yi/ /skyon ni nam yang min pa nyid/ /ces pas 'khrul nas/ skyon yon gyi brtag pa byar mi rung ngo zhes zer ba ni/ rgyud sde kun tu slob dpon gyi skyon yon rgya cher gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhes bkag cing*/ dbang mchog thob gang zhes pa dbang bzhi thob pa'i slob dpon so ske tha mal par lus pa la/ slob ma sangs rgyas zin pas kyang phyogs bcu nas dus gsum du byon te phyag byed par bshad pa ma yin nam snyam pa na/ nges don du/ dbang mchog ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i skad cig tha ma yin la| slob ma sangs rgyas zin pas kyang phyogs bcu nas dus gsum du byon te/ de byang chub shing drung du thob pa'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa la/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis phyag byed pa na dbu rgyan la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang phyag byed pa yin la/ drang don la slob dpon phal pa la phyogs bcu'i slob mas phyag byed pa na de dag gi phung po rnams de bzhin gshegs par byas pas phyag byed pa'o/

/zhes gsungs shing*/ 'dir bum pa dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba rnams kyi bdun du zhes pa/ agra mchog tu bsgyur rgyu mdun du bsgyur ba'i skyon te/ dbang bskur ba rnams kyi mchog phyag rgya chen mo zhes bsgyur dgos te/ dbang mchog thob gang zhes pa'i bshad pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam bshad rig par/ mchog gi sgra ni gtso bo dang*| |dang po rtse mo mdun gyi don/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir phyag byed pa'i tshe dbu rgyan mi 'bud pa yang bstan to/ /yang rab byung dang dge slong gtso bor bya ba'i don du/ khyim pa dang gsar bu la phyag byed dgos pa byung na/ glegs bam sogs mdun du byas nas de la phyag byed pa ltar ma byas na 'jig rten pas smod par yang gsungs so/ /de yang chos 'chad pa'i tshe na bya'i/ skabs gzhan du phyag mi byed la/ rang las bslab pa rgan pa'i dge slong rdo rje slob dpon la nyin re lan gsum du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal bya zhing*/ mi byed na rmongs pa dang sdig can gyi gtso bo dang mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni rdo rje 'chang nyid de'i cha byad bstan nas 'jig rten du 'byon pas/ de mnyes ma mnyes las lha mnyes ma mnyes su 'gyur tshul ye le'i mjug tu gsungs shing*/ rgyud gzhan du yang*/ gal te lha ni mnyes 'dod na/ /'bad pas snga mar mnyes par bya// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la/ de ltar na yang*/ gsar bu dang khyim pa la slob dpon yin yang phyag dang rkang pa bkru ba sogs mi byed pa ni/ yid kyis shin tu gus par byed dgos mod kyi/ lus ngag gis gus tshul che na/ le lo'i dbang gis sdom pa gong ma la che cher mi byed pa'i rkyen du 'gyur zhing*/ bstan pa spyi'i bsnyen bkur gyi rim pa la gnod par dwogs te/ 'dul bar yang*/ gnas bla mar rang las bslab pa gzhon na 'dud pa 'ba' zhig ma gtogs so zhes phyag mi bya bar bshad pa dang mthun no//

gnyis pa ni/ 'dul bar/ slob dpon la gus tshul khrims yongs dag dang*/ /bsam gtan dang ni 'don la rtag brtson dang*/ /grims shing dul la bzod dang ldan pa ni/ /sdom brtson gnas pa'i chos ldan shes par bya| |zhes sogs dang*/ rgyud las/ de ltar slob ma snying rje gtong*/ /tshul khrims bzod pa'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ 'dir zab cing rgya che la sems sogs yon tan dgu po yongs su rdzogs na rdzogs rim dang*/ shas cher rdzogs na bsod nams kyi rgyu bskyed rim dang*/ phal cher ma tshang na re zhig dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa la sogs pa byin nas smin par byed du gzhug go / de yang kyai rdor las/ dang po gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjais bslab pa'i gnas bcu byin/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /zhes sogs nas/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai yi rdo rje bstan/ /zhes sogs ltar/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi sgo nas bsdu ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas dang*/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse rnams las kyang gsungs pas/ bsdur mi rung ba'i slob ma med do zhes rong pa'i ngag rgyun las 'byung ba ches legs pa yin gyi/ sngags kyi snod du re zhig mi rung ba rnams la sdang smras kyis 'dor zhing*/ smod pa byed pa ni slob dpon gyi bya ba ma yin no/ /des na spyir gzhan phan gyi bsam sbyor lhur len mkhan dang*/ khyad par rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yin na/ gdul bya mchog dman mtha' dag gang la gang 'tsham gyi lam gyis rjes su bzung ba'i brtse sems khyad par can dang thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar na gang zag la dri ma glo bur ba'i cha nas mchog dman shin tu che ba dang*/ de la bltos nas gsungs pa'i gsung rab kyi dngos bstan la yang mchog dman shin tu che ba'i tshul la yang nges pa rnyed pa zhig dang*/ gang zag gi rang bzhin rnam dag dang gsung rab kyi sbas don shugs bstan la mchog dman med par chos dang gang zag gi mnyam pa nyid thams cad khong du chud nas chags sdang dang blang dor med pa'i dad gus ro gcig gi nyams len la nges pa rnyed pa gnyis tshogs pa ni shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i nyams len yin par shes par bya'o/

/sngags la 'jug pa'i gang zag gi yon tan yang*| spyir btang la skyes bu gsum gyi lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs nas 'jug par gsungs kyang*/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las la la gsang sngags bsgrub don gnyer/ /'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer| |zhes sogs/ kun slong tha ma tshe 'di'i nad zhi sogs/ 'bring phyi ma lha mi tsam/ rab sangs rgyas don gnyer gsum las/ dang po gnyis dor nas phyi ma bcos nas kyang kun slong 'chos tshul gsungs la/ rgyud tshig de dag bla med kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga khungs thub du mar yang drangs nas bshad cing*/ lam thun mong bas rgyud 'byongs pa la kun slong gsar du 'chos don med pa'i phyir ro// slob ma'i grangs kyang*/ spyi rgyud du/ gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma bzung*/ /de las lhag pa'i slob ma dag /yongs su bzung bar mi shes so/ /zhes dang*/ kha 'chams na grangs kyi kha skong ming byang tsam la brten nas kyang byed tshul bshad pa bzhin/ bla med kyi nang nas da ri kā'i bde mchog gi dkyil chog du bshad la/ bod kyi bla ma mang po yang 'dir mi rung ba'i dam tshig skad du mdzad nas/ slob ma'i grangs cung zad lhag pa rnams la sdang smras mang du byed pa dag snang mod kyi/ bya rgyud kyi yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du slob ma'i grangs brgyad du gsungs shing*/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang las/ slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa/ /de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la dad/ /zab mo yi ni blo dang ldan| spro ba che zh-ing tshul khrims ldan/ /bzod dang zhi zhing ser sna med| |dpa' ba yi dam brtan pa ni/ /bcu'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga// gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung*/ /dpyad mi dgos par bzung bar bya// zhes bshad cing dkyil chog rdor rje phreng du/ /gcig gam gnyis sam mang po dag kyang rung ste zhes bshad la 'dir ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal gyi gzhal med khang chen por 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa'i tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dus gcig la dbang bskur bar gsungs pas/

snod du rung na grangs la nges pa med cing*/ de yang 'jug pa tsam gyi snod la sdom pa mi 'dzin kyang*/ sngags la mos pa nges par dgos la/ slob ma dang slob dpon gyi dbang gi snod la rim pa bzhin/ byang sems kyi sdom pa tsam dang*/ de dang sngags sdom gnyis ka 'dzin nus nges par dgos so/ / gsum pa ni/ dus kyi nang nas lo la/ rgya nag lugs la/ mche ba can gyi lo bzhi la drag las bya bar bshad pa sogs lo 'di la 'di bzang gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad kyang*/ rgya gar lugs la de ltar bshad pa ma mthong na'ang*/ sangs rgyas lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ sku bltams pa dang*/ sangs rgyas pa rnams chu mo phag dang*/ shing pho byi ba dang*/ sa mo phag rnams yin pas/ bya ba chen po rnams de dag la byas na bzang bar gsal zhing*/ khyad par dgung lo don brgyad pa/ lcags mo phag rdzogs/ spyi don dang por/ bdun cu don brgyad lcags sbrul la/ /zla bzang la sogs 'khor mang la/ /dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /gong 'og ma mthun pas brtag go chu pho byi ba la dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du dus kyi 'khor lo gsungs pas lo de ni lugs 'di la mchog tu bsngags shing*/ de bzhin du shing pho spre'u la sham+bha la'i ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal du 'jam dbyangs kyis nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang du dbang bskur zhing bsdus rgyud bsdus pas lo 'di yang mchog tu bsngags so/ /de bzhin du rab byung gi lor grags pa me mo yos la rgya gar du dus 'khor phebs pas lo de yang ngo/ /lo'i cha shas kyi dus ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs nas ston zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ dpyid zla tha chung gi bar zla ba bdun ni dngos grub sgrub pa'i dus dang*/ dbyar gyi dus nad gdon zhi ba sogs kyi las bsgrub tu rung ba bshad la/ 'dir ni spyir chu srin sogs byang bgrod kyi zla ba drug 'od zer gyi lam zhes bya ba nyi ma steng nas steng du 'gro bas gnas 'og ma nas gong mar 'gro ba dang mthun pa'i phyir na sangs rgyas pa'i dus zhes bya ba yin pas dge ba'i las rnams shis shing*/

karka ṭa sogs drug de las ldog pa du ba'i lam zhes bya ba kla klo'i dus yin pas sdig pa dang sdig pa ltar snang ba'i las rnams kyi dus su bshad cing*/ 'phral du'ang dgun nyi log pa la dgar snang dang*| dbyar nyi ldog pa la mi dga' ba'i snang ba phal cher la myong bas grub pa'i phyir na bshad pa snga ma ni ston lo tog gi 'bras bu la longs spyod pa tsam gyi sgo nas bshad par mngon no/ khyad par lug glang 'khrig gsum lta bu dus sbyor gsum tshan rnams la brtan g.yo mnyam gsum bshad nas g.yo ba la bya ba bsgrub na myur ba dang*/brtan pa la bul ba dang*/ mnyam pa la 'bring du gsung pa'ang yod la/ khyim zla bcu gnyis kyi zhing bdag gi gza' lngar bshad pa ltar/ res gza' bdun po rim pa bzhin/ seng nyi ma/ ge dang*/ karka zla ba/ ṭa dang*/ lug mig dmar/ sdig dang*/ 'khrig pa lhag pa/ bu mo dang*/ gzhu phur bu/ nya dang*| glang pa sangs/ srang dang*/ chu spen pa/ bum gyi bdag po yin pas zla ba rab dang*/ nyi ma dang zhi gza' gnyis 'bring dang*/ drag gza' gsum gyis zhing bdag byed pa'i khyim zla de la dbang dang rab gnas sogs 'dzem dgos shing*/ 'on kyang rgyal gyi nya la rgyal po dang*/ nag pa'i nya la sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus yin pas 'di pa'i dbang bskur ba'i dus dang*/ bdud bcom pa'i nyin zhag sa ga'i nya la'ang de bzhin gsungs shing*/ de dag las ma grub na nya gzhan la sbyor ba dang*/ gza' skar bzang na tshes gzhan la'ang bya bar gsungs so| |gsang ba spyi rgyud dang rab gnas kyi rgyud du tshes grangs dang gza' skar gyi nges pa'ang gsungs te/ de dag sngags rim dang rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho sogs las shes par bya'o/ /bye brag tu phur sangs nyi ma la la nub pa'i dus su bag ma dang rab gnas 'dzem par gsungs so/ / bzhi pa la/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ lag len so sor bshad pa'o// dang po la/ rgyud sde spyi dang*/ bye brag gi cho ga'o/

/ dang po ni/ bya ba spyi'i cho ga gsang ba spyi rgyud nas/ slob dpon gyis bsnyen pa bya tshul dang*/ dai rjes/ rnam dpyad dang pos sa gzhi bzung*/ /gnyis pa la ni sta gon bya/ /nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis/ /zhes pa cho ga sta gon dngos gzhi mjug chog dang bcas pa phal cher rgyas la gsal bar gsungs pa ni rgyud sde gong ma'i dkyil chog tshad ldan rnams su yang thun mong ba rnams phal cher drangs shing*/ dbang chog la chu dang cod pan tsam las med pa rnams kyi steng du/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang*/ phyag rdor dbang bskur sogs nas rdaur dril ming gsum bsnan zhing*/ yo ga'i bshad rgyud rtse mo dang bcas pa'i rtsa rgyud du rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gsang dbang rjes mthun dang pa bcas pa gsal la rgyas par gsungs pa rnams la bla med kyi rgyud sde kun tu zhal 'phangs mdzad de/ brtag gnyis su/ mang du smos kyang ci zhig bya/ /ji ltar de nyid bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro| |bla med kyi dbang chog ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ cho ga nyi shur bsdus nas gsal bar gsungs shing*/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad par grags pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa ni bod kyi rdzun mar snang mod kyi/ klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu pa ni/ rgya bod kun gyis tshad ldan du byed cing*/ khyad par 'phags yul gyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras shes byed kyi gtso bor mdzad cing*/ mar me mdzad bzang po'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa yang kun gyi khungs su byed pas/ sa ra ha'i sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil chog sogs kyang yod mod kyi/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i dkyil chog gi gzhung gi gtso bo ni klu byang gi nyi shu pa dang*/ mar me mdzad kyi bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa gnyis dang*/ yo ga'i kun snying gi rdo rje 'byung ba rnams dang*/ de rjes a bha ya'i rdo rje phreng ba dang*/

de'i rjes 'brang gi bi bhū ti dang*| rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang*/ khyad par me long dga' ba'i dar paṇa ā tsār+ya'i kṛ ya sa muts+tsha rnams legs par bslab par bya ba yin no/ /de la klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu pa ni/ gzhung der ji skad du/ dang por sa ni sbyang ba dang*/ /de nas sa yongs 'dzin pa dang*/ /phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi zhing*/ thod le dkar gyi thig gdab dang*| |de nas sa lha sogs lhag par/ /gnas dang de nas gsol gdab dang*// phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang*/ /nam mkhar thig ni gdab pa dang*/ /tshon sna lnga yi cho ga dang*/ /de nas tshig ni dgye ba dang*/ /lha rnams spyan drangs nyid dang ni| |de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang*/ khrus kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang*/ /de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang*/ /de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur dang*/ /lha dang snga mar yon gnyis dang*/ /rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang*/ /de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang*/ /dkyil 'khor las byed phur bu dang*/ /skud pa bsdu ba nyid kyang ste/ /rab bshad cho ga nyi shu yis/ /ji ltar ji ltar rgyas shes pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams te/ bshad rgyud rdor phreng dang go rim cung zad mi mthun yang grangs dang rnam gzhag mtha' dag rgyu sde de la brten pa'o/ /slob dpon a bha yas de dag gi steng du rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba gzhan 'dra yang bsnan zhing*/ dbang la dbye ba mdzad nas slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad cho ga lnga bcur bsdus nas gsungs pa ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'-i mchod yon dang*/ mchod yon la sogs pa 'bul ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i dgos pa dang*/ slob ma bsdu ba dang*/ sa brko ba dang*/ sa sbyang ba dang*/ sa yongs su bzung ba dang*/ bgegs la phur bus gdab pa dang*/ nor 'dzin ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ bum pa lhag par gnas pa dang*/ lha lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa dang*/

tshon bkye ba dang*/ bum pa dgod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang*/ lha rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rab gnas dang*/ rdzing bu la sogs pa'i rab gnas dang*/ ā mra'i skyes mos tshal la sogs pa'i rab gnas dang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ slob dpon 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ ming gi dbang dang*/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis dbang dang*/ sngags sbyin pa dang*/ mig sman dang*/ me long dang*/ mda' 'phang ba dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ dbang bzhi pa dang*| rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang*/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang*/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ lung bstan pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ rab dbang bskur ba dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang*/ yid kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bgegs bsal ba dang*/ rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid dang bzung ba ste/ cho ga lnga bcus bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes so// slob dpon dga' ba'i me long gis/ sa yongs su brtag pa dang*/ sa'i sel dbyung ba dang*/ sa sel la thig gdab pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ mchod yon gyi go cha dang*| rnying pa gso ba dang*/ mchod yon la sogs pa sbyin pa'i nges pa dang*/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i dgos pa dang*/ slob ma bsdu ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa bya ba dang*/ sa yongs su bzung ba dang */ bgegs la phur bus gdab pa dang*/ nor 'dzin ma lhag par sar gnas pa sogs gsum dang*/ thig skud lhag par gnas pa dang*/ nam mkha' la thig gdab pa dang*/ dkar pos thig gdab pa dang*| dkyil 'khor la thig gdab pa dang*/ tshon gyi bzlas pa dang*/ tshon bkye ba sogs gsum dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad bsdus te bsgom pa dang*/ sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rab gnas dang*/ bgrang phreng gi mtshan nyid dang*/ rgyal mtshan gzugs pa dang*/ rdzing bu la sogs pa'i rab tu gnas pa sogs gnyis dang*/

dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la sogs pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rang gis dbang blang ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang*/ sbom po'i ltung ba dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ yid kyi sbyin sreg dang*/ tshogs kyi bza' ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu sogs gsum dang*/ gza' yum la sogs pas bde legs su byed pa dang*/ bgegs bsal ba dang*/ sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ khams kyi yon tan dang*| shing la sogs pa'i sel dbyung ba dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid dang*/ rdor dril bzung ba dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha'i mtshan nyid dang*/ nags tshal gyi ltad mo dang*/ khru'i tshad dang*| gaṇ+ḍi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ mchod rten la sogs pa'i srog shing gzugs pa dang*| sgo'i shing gzugs pa dang*/ ka ba gzugs pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i rtse mor shing gzugs pa dang*/ dri gtsang khang la sogs pa'i dang*/ tshad kyi 'jal ba'i dang*/ rgya phubs la sogs pa'i dang*/ bsam gtan gyi khang pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ shi ba'i rus bu dag par byed pa'i cho ga ste/ cho ga drug cu rtsa bzhi bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes bshad de/ rgyud dang klu byang gis ni dkyil chog rkyang pa'i dbang du mdzad la/ phreng ba dang kṛ ya sa muts+tsha gnyis kyis ni de dang 'brel ba'i bya ba spyi'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ de gnyis kyang bsdus rgyas kyi khyad par yin zhing*/ phyi ma la gza' yum nor rgyun ma rnams gsung pa gsum so sor bgrang*/ rdor dril so sor bgrang na cho ga drug cu rtsa bzhi yod do// de dag kyang kho bos byas pa'i bde dgyes gsang 'dus sogs kyi dkyil chog rnams dang*/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan nas lag len dus 'khor la gtso bor sbyar ba'i rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho/ sbyin sreg cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho/ tshogs 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi rgya mtsho/

lho sgo'i cho ga sgrib pa kun sbyong rnams las legs par bshad pas de dag la bslab par bya'o/ khyad par bla med kyi dbang gi rnam gzhag ni/ rgyal po an+d+ri bhu ti'i dbang gi man ngag rin chen 'khor lo dang*/ mkhas pa chen po ye shes rdo rje zhes grags pa/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i sras kyi gtso bo bzhi/ kun snying gi bla ma bzhi'i nang nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa des mdzad pa'i rtsod pa'i dang*/ sngags lam gyi rim pa ste rim pa gnyis pa zhes grags pa'i bstan bcos las legs par bshad pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi la cher ma grags pa gnyis snang bas 'dir gnyis las gsungs pa rnams der mdor bsdus te go sla bar bri bar bya'o/ /de yang dang pos dbang bzhi ka yang don nyi shu'i nyi shus legs par bshad de/ gleng gzhi dang*/ gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ slob ma dang*| dkyil 'khor dang*/ der 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang gi rnam grangs dang*/ bskur ba'i lus kyi gnas dang*/ thabs dang*/ sbyang bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ thob bya'i sa dang*/ nyams len gyi lam dang*/ rtags dang*/ brda dang*/ dbang rdzas dang*/ bsam don gyi dgongs pa dang*/ byed las kyi nus pa dang*/ 'bras bu rnams so/ /de la bum dbang gi gleng gzhi ni/ rgyal ba sku bltams dus klu'i rgyal pos bum chu blug pa dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du lung bstan pa dang*| 'tshang rgya khar sa'i lha mos bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang bum pa phul ba la sogs pa'o/ /gsang dbang gi gleng gzhi ni/ dpal 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi thog mar rdo rje 'chang 'dod chags chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gzungs ma rnams sprul te/ bde chen la rol nas byang sems rnams la dbang bskur ba'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi gleng gzhi ni/ rgyud dang*/ rgyud der sngags kyi spyod pa khyad par can bstan pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngus te brgyal zhing rmongs pa las bslang ste sbas don bstan pa'o/

/bzhi pa'i gleng gzhi ni/ rgyud der 'khor gyi byang sems rnams kyis gsang ba'i yi ge mthong ba'i skal ba bdag cag la med do zhes ngus pa na/ ston pas yi ge rnam par dag/ces yi ge las dben pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du dbang bzhi'i gnas ni rim pa bzhin/ phyi rol gyi ri dang sman ljongs dang dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa sogs lus kyi khams yid dang rjes su mthun pa dang*/ phyi'i rig ma tshad ldan gyi phyi'i dbyibs dang*/ nang gi rtsa 'khor dang*/ mthar thug gi gnas lugs la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes rnams so/ /dus bzhi ni/ bla mas gnang*/ slob ma 'dod/ chos 'byung zhing bsgrub pa'i dus dang*/ bum dbang rdzogs/ rig ma zla mtshan dang ldan de dang bla mas gnang ba'i dus dang*/ dbang gnyis rdzogs/ rig ma dgyes shing bla mas gnang ba'i dus dang*/ blang dor gzung 'dzin dus gsum sogs med pa'i dus chen po'o/ /

slob dpon bzhi ni/ dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid pa dang*/ thabs bla ma/ shes rab rig ma/ gnyis med thugs 'dres pa ste gsum dang*/ phyi bla ma/ nang rig ma ste gnyis dang*/ gnyis med rang rig chen po'i de kho na nyid mthong ba'i rang sems so/ /slob ma bzhi ni*/ sngags dang rgyud la mos pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid spyi tshang ba/ rtsa ba'i sngags ci rigs pa sngon du bzlas pa dang bum dbang rdzogs shing snying po bzlas pa nang gi brtul zhugs dang*| dam tshig la mos pa dang*/ dbang gnyis rdzogs shing sbas don khyad par can la mos/ nye snying bzlas pa dang*/ dbang gsum rdzogs/ don dam tha snyad kyi gnas lugs gnyis dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yul can no/ / dkyil 'khor ni/ bum dbang la slob ma rab 'bring mtha' gsum la rim pa bzhin/ ting nge 'dzin/ me tog rdul tshon no/ /gzhan yang lugs ma/ 'bur ma/ bris ma/ glegs bam/ mchod rten bla ma'i lus zhes bshad pa'i phyi ma gsum mas rim bzhin/ lus dkyil/ blos longs/ gzungs thag rnams su gsal lo/ /de dag bsgrub pa la sngon du bsnyen pa/ sa sbyangs*/ bgegs bsal/ sa bzung*/ sta gon bzhi/ thig gdab/ tshon bkye/ rgyan bkod/ dgug 'jug mchod pa rnams bshad/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa mi gsal yang*/ sogs/ ji ltar grags pa'i cho gas bya/ /zhes pas kha skong gang dgos ston no/ /gsang dbang gi phyag rgya mtshan ldan rnams kyi phyi'i lus kyi mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon bzhi ni zur bzhi sogs rdzogs pa stai/ de la yang brtag blang sbyang bzung byin rlabs tshogs 'khor rnams rgyud bzhin no/ /shes rab ye shes kyi rig ma mtshan ldan snga ma ltar sbyangs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang gi rtsa 'khor drug gam bzhi/ khyad par gsang ba'i chos 'byung ste/ de yang brtag blang bzung byin rlabs rgyud bzhin no// bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems//

bla na med pa'i thugs chud pa/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gang*/ /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor de rnams su 'jug pa'i cho ga bzhi ni rim pa ltar/ sta gon sngon du 'gro bas chas 'jug nas dkyil 'khor ston pa'i bar spyi 'gro bzhin dang*/ bum chus bkru/ yol bas bcad/ gsol ba gdab/ mig dar bcings/ me tog gtad/ nang du drangs/ bskor ba dang phyag bsdus pa byed du gzhug nang gi dam bzhag ye shes dbab/ me tog dor| mig dar phye/ lus dkyil rdzogs par bstan pa rnams dang*/ gzhan de ji bzhin la/ mig dar phye nas mar me bteg ste/ rig ma'i mtshan dpe dang*/ chu skyes bstan/ yid ngor rtsa 'khor bstan pa rnams dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i gsung rab thos pa dang*/ don rtogs pa dang*/ de goms pa dang*/ mngon du gyur pa rnams mig dar phye ba dang dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang*/ der zhugs pa dngos grub thob pa rnams su gyur pa rnams so/ /dbang bskur bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ me tog phreng ba/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs gsum byin pa dang bcas pa'i slob dpon/ dbugs dbyung lung bstan phyir mi ldog pa rnams dang*/ yab yum gyi dkar dmar spel ba phreng ba/ rlan pa chu/ spyi bor reg pa cod pan/ lce thog tu rdo rje bzhag pa rdo rje/ hūm̐ sgrog pa dril bu/ a ho su kha ming*/ lces blangs pa brtul zhugs/ mig lam du mi snang ba lung bstan/ bde ba thob pa dbugs dbyung*| longs spyod kyi rlangs btsir ba phyir mi ldog pa rnams dang*/ chags pa 'phel ba phreng ba/ chu byung ba chu/ lan bu bzung ba cod pan/ pad+mar rdo rje bcug pa de bskyod pa/ ha skad rnams rdor dril ming*/ slar yang*/ ltas dgod 'khyud gsum dam tshig gsum/ nu ma mnyed pa/ 'o byed pa/ pad+ma bsdams pa rnams lung bstan sogs gsum rnams dang*/ bzhi pa'i ye shes dngos su nyams su myong ba rnams so/ /dbang bzhi pa'i rnam grangs ni rim pa bzhin/

bum dbang la phyi nang sbas gsum/ phyi la pha rgyud man la grags pa'i bum chu dang*/ de la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsres pa gnyis thun mong ba dang khyad par gyi bum pa'o/ /nang gi bla med la grags pa'i nang dbang*/ sbas pa la thabs kyi sbas pa/ spyi bo nas byang sems 'babs pas thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' mnyes pa/ shes rab kyi sbas pa yum dang mkha' gsang sbyar ba'i rdo rje nor bu sbyangs ba'o/ /de ltar bum dbang nyid la dbang bzhi'i tha snyad sbyar te/ phyi gnyis re re/ nang dang sbas pa nyid gnyis gcig de gsum yod de/ las grol bar rtogs pa rnams bum pa'i bum pa/ bum pa'i gsang ba sogs so/ /gsang dbang la yang byang sems khar byin pa phyi/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab gang ba nang*/ 'og sgor bde ba skyes pa sbas pa'o/ /dbang bzhi dang sbyor tshul mkha' gsang nas chu 'babs pa dang*/ gsang rdzas myongs pa dang*/ bde ba skyes pa dang*/ mi rtog gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i bum pa sogs so/ /gsum pa la yang rig ma gtad pa/ rtsa nang du bde ba myong ba| lhan skyes rdzogs pa rnams phyi nang sbas pa/ lus la lha dgod pa/ mkha' gsang reg pa/ bde chen myong ba/ gnyis snang nub pa rnams gsum pa'i bum dbang sogs so/ /bzhi pa la yang*/ gzhan la yang dbang sbyin pa'i nus pa thogs med dang*/ theg pa rab 'byams kyi dbang gi rnam grangs shes pa dang*/ nges don du dbang bsam mi khyab tu rtogs pa rnams so/ /'di la bzhi sbyor tshul ma gsungs so/ /dbang bskur ba'i lus kyi gnas bzhi ni/ spyi mgrin snying gsum dang gnas mi dmigs pa rnams so/ /thabs bzhi ni/ dpon slob sbyin blang bsam pa mthun pa dang*/ snga ma yab yum gyi sgo gsum dag par mthun pa dang*| rig ma'i bde ba dang por sems dang phyi nas lus kyi myong ba'i ma mtha' longs spyod kyi rlabs btsir ba dang/ dmigs med ye shes chen po la/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba mi 'gog pa'i thabs dang thabs byung bsam yas rnams so/

/sbyang bya bzhi ni/ lus kyi gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum/ rang rig ye shes rgyal po nyid 'khor bar snang ba la sgrib pa rnams so/ /thob bya bzhi ni/ bum dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthong ba tshogs lam/ 'phreng ba sbyor lam/ chu cod pan sa dang po/ gzhan gsum brgyad pa'i bar/ brtul zhugs sogs/ lhag mas sa bcu rnams so/ /mchog dbang gsum ni/ sangs rgyas ni sa dang po dang*/ gnyis pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dang*/ ye shes tha snyad kun mkhyen yul las 'das pa gnyis su med pa'i sa rnams thob bo/ /lam bzhi ni/ dkyil 'khor bṛ bsgrub sogs slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ bskyed rim las tshogs dang bcas pa sogs te| mdor na rgyud kyi 'chad tshul mtha' drug gi nang nas drang don dang sgra ji bzhin pa dang*/ dgongs min gsum/ tshul bzhi'i nang nas yig don spyi don gnyis| bshad pa gnyis nang nas tshogs bshad kyi lam rnams bskyed rim gyi smin byed bum dbang gi lam/ nges don sgra ji bzhin pa min pa/ dgongs pa can te gsum dang*/ sbas don la mthar thug gi don gnyis dang*/ slob bshad kyi lam rnams rdzogs rim smin byed mchog dbang gsum gyi lam ste/ de yang 'dir gsang sngags la/ gsang ba dang sbas don zhes pa tsam dang*/ gsum pa la yul can sems kyi 'od gsal gzung 'dzin 'gog pa'i lam/ steng sgo rlung dang 'og sgo thig le'i lam zhes bsdus nas rlung bcu la brten pa'i rdor bzlas sogs gsungs shing*/ bzhi pa la/ rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal zhing*/ /rdzogs pa chen po mthar thug pa/ /man ngag kun kyi mchog gi mchog /de sgrub thabs su gsungs par bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ gsum pa la/ thig le bde chen gyi lam gtso bor ston pa dang sbrel nas rtsa rlung gsungs par zad kyi/ rtsa rlung gzugs sku'i sgrub byed rnams gsang dbang gis lam du mi bzhed pa ma yin no/ /rtags bzhi ni/ dngos grub kyi rtags so shing*/ rmi lam bar snang gi kha dog sogs dang*/

pho mo'i bde ba che chung dang*| smig rgyu du ba sogs mtshan ma dang*/ glang po rnyed nas rjes kyis mtshon mi dgos par ltar/ rang rig mngon gyur rtags dang bral ba rnams so/ /brda bzhi ni| lus brda lngas bsdus rtse mnan dang / mthe bos srin lag mnan pa dang*/ / de gnyis legs sbyar lus brda dang*/ ngag brda dbang rang rang gi skabs su bab pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo'i skad du smra ba rnams dang*/ bzhi pa brda dang brda min thams cad las grol ba'o/ /dbang rdzas bzhi ni/ me tog gi 'phreng ba dang*/ bum chus dbu rgyan sogs te/ pha rgyud dang ma rgyud la rin po che dang*/ thod skam so sor sogs spyi 'gro bzhin dang*/ me long mig sman dang/ 'khor lo dung glegs sogs/ bya spyod sogs dang thun mong ba rin chen sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad nye ba'i dang bcas pa rnams dang*| dbugs dbyung la yon tan/ lung bstan la chos gos/ phyir mi ldog la de kho na nyid rnams bum dbang gi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gsang dbang gi slob ma'i byang sems/ rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas rnams gsum pa'i/ snang srid rdo rje gsum la spang blang dang bral ba'i ye shes bzhi pa'o/ /dgongs pa'am bsam don ni/ slob ma la dmigs pa spo ba dang*/ dag pa sogs kyi dbang don ngo sprod par byed pa rnams kun slong spyir tshad med bzhi/ dgos dbang rang rang gi lam dang 'bras bu la sbyor 'dod kyis bskyed pa rnams spyi 'gro yongs grags bzhin dang*/ khyad par me tog phreng ba la lha dang me tog slob ma la thim par bsam pa dang*/ dbang gsum la slob ma'i rtsa 'khor drug gam bzhi la dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge 'god pa dang*/ dmar cha gyen du 'bar bas bsregs/ sna sgo nas 'thon pas rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan bkug nas zhugs/ dkar cha mar babs pas gsos/ dhū tīr dkar dmar 'dres pa la brten par bzung nas lhan skyes bskyed tshul/ zhal lung grol thig

o la pa ti sogs dang mthun pa dang*/ bzhi pa rang rig brjod bral la ngo sprod pa rnams so/ /nus pa bzhi'i bum dbang sogs re la/ dri ma 'khru/ sdig pa sbyang las byed/ 'bras bu la sbyor/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa ste lnga lnga bshad la/ bum dbang la/ phreng ba dang chu cod pan/ gzhan gsum/ slob dpon 'khor bcas rnams kyis rim pa bzhin ma dad pa dang*/ gnyis snang*/ rnam g.yeng lnga dang g.yeng ba phra mo'i dri ma rnams 'khru| mos spyod dang*/ sa dang po dang*/ brgyad pa'i bar dang*/ bcu pa'i bar gyi sgrib pa sbyong*/ 'dod lha mnyes/ rigs gnyis kyi dang*/ gsum gyi nga rgyal bskyed| bla ma rnams brtan par byed pa'i las bzhi byed la/ de yang brtul zhugs gnyis kyis phreng ba/ phyag rgyas chu cod pan/ lung bstan sogs kyi rdor dril ming gsum brtan par byed ces so/ /'bras bu mthong lam| sgom lam/ mthar phyin sangs rgyas pa rnams la phyogs par byed/ bdud/ phung po/ nyon mongs / 'chi bdag lha'i bu'i bdud rnams 'joms pa'o/ /gsang dbang gi ngag gi dri ma 'khru/ sa bcu gcig pa'i sgrib pa sbyong*/ thabs shes rab dang bde stong dbyer med nges par byed/ sa bcu gcig pa la phyogs/ bdud bzhi ni/ thabs dang*/ shes rab dang*/ gnyis med dang*/ sems 'phro ba rnams kyi rim pas 'joms so/ /gsum pa'i nus pa ni/ sems kyi dri ma 'khru/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa sbyong*/ phyag rgya rten brten par byed/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyogs/ bdud bzhi ni/ yas rim rtsa 'khor bzhi'am/ dga' ba bzhi'am/ mkha' gsang reg bcug bskyod/ bde ba babs pa rnams kyi rim pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bla ma rnams kyi spang gnyen shin tu phra ba rnams sbyong zhing bskyed pa'o/ /nyi shu pa 'bras bu bzhi ni/ spyir re re la/ bdag 'bras/ rgyu mthun/ rnam smin/ byed 'bras/ bral 'bras te lnga yin la/ bum dbang gi phreng ba/ chu/ cod pan/ rdor dril/ ming*| brtan byed rnams kyi de lnga rim bzhin no/

/gsang dbang gi lnga ni/ yab yum tshogs pa/ byang sems rgyas pa/ lces myangs pa/ bde ba skyes pa/ stong pa nges pa rnams so/ /gsum pa'i lnga ni/ yab yum sbyar ba/ lte snying mgrin dpral rnams su byang sems 'bab pa'o/ /bzhi pa la ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi tha snyad thams cad dang bral ba'i rgyus mchog gi mchog go /de ltar dbang bzhi don nyi shus ston pa chos rgyal in+d+ra bhū ti'i rin chen 'khor lo bsdus te bshad pa yin pas rgyas par de nyid du blta'o/ slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes ni/ spyir rgyud sde thams cad kṛ ya/ yo ga rnal 'byor chen po/ rnam 'byor bla med ste/ rgyud sde bzhir bsdus la/ de yang bya spyod gc-ig tu byas pa dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ bla med kyi pha rgyud ma rgyud rnams so/ /de bzhin rim pa bzhin skyes gnas/ rdzus/ drod/ mngal| sgo nga bzhi dang*/ nyon mongs/ nga rgyal/ gti mug phrag dogazhe sdang rnams sbyongs/ skyed chog gsum bskyed/ lnga bskyed/ mngal 'byin/ rten dang brten pa cig car bskyed pa'o/ /bskyed chog gi rgyu mtshan ni/ mtshan brjod kyi| so so rang rig mi g.yo ba/ /sogs rkang pa gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i sogs gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa po/ /sogs gnyis dang*| theg le chen po yi ge med/ /sogs tshigs bcad gsum rnams so// dgos pa ni/ bla ma gnyis la ma sbyar zhing*/ phyi ma gnyis la/ mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /sogs gnyis dang*/ ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa/ /sogs gnyis so/ /yang bskyed chog bzhi po re re la yang*/ skye gnas bzhi ste/ bya spyod kyi tshogs zhing rdzus skyes/ gsum skyes sgo nga*/ sa bon bskul ba drod/ gnyis med ye shes mngal lo/ /lnga bskyed kyi bsnyen pa/ rnal 'byor chen po/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rnams rim pa bzhin/ rdzus sgong drod mngal/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rnal 'byor dang*/

rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po rnams drod sgong mngal rdzus so/ /rnal 'byor ma'i/ dang po sbyor ba/ rjes chags/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog rnams| drod rdzus mngal sgong ngo*/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi las bla med gnyis thun mong gi dbang bzhi re re yang cho ga bcu bdun bcu bdun tshang bar gsungs so// sa btsal/ brtag blang*/ bzung*/ bcad/ sbyang*/ rtsig pa ste sa chog bdun tshang bar sta gon la/ sa/ lha/ bum/ slob ma sta gon te bzhi/ thigatshon/ rgyan/ sgrub/ 'jug dbang skur ba ste dngos gzhi la drug rnams so/ /bcu bdun po bsdu na/ sa chog lha gnas/ sgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba ste bzhir 'dus/ dbang bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ni bum dbang spyi dang mthun/ gzhan gsum la/ slob dpon gyi lus dang*/ mkha' gsang dang*/ sems kyi dkyil 'khor rnams so/ /bum dbang gi cho ga bcu bdun po'i gzhan rnams spyi 'gro bzhin/ sa bcad pa ni/ gsol 'dab dang bka' bsgo stangs stabs sogs so/ /rtsig pa ni/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sa stegs brtsig pa'o/ /cho ga de rnams kyi phan yon bum dbang gi sa chog bdun gyi rim pa bzhin/ yul dbus kyi sa phyogs ming bkra shis par skye ba dang*/ zhing khams dang rgyal srid dag par skye ba dang*/ bar chad med par sa la dbang zhing bcud skye ba dang*/ rnam snang gi sku 'grub cing sa thob pa dang*/ dgos pa'i sa zin zhing khams lnga thob pa dang*/ gzhan don 'grub cing dag pa'i zhing myur du 'grub pa dang*/ kun tu 'gro ba'i zhing 'chags shing mi nyams pas yid dga' ba rnams so/ /sta gon bzhi'i phan yon ni/ bar chad med par sa la dbang ba'i snang ba 'byung ba dang*/ dam tshig gtsang zhing chos 'khor bskor ba'i 'gro don nus pa dang*/ dbang gis rgyud rlan zhing sngags spyod ston nus pa dang*/ bdag nyid chen po gyur te/ 'khor bsdus nas byang chub pa'o/ /dngos gzhi drug ni/

sgom 'chad mi nor ba dang*/ shes rab gsal zhing 'phel ba dang*/ sdug bsngal spong zhing snod bcud kyi zhing mdzes sdug rgyas pa dang*/ lha dang gsang sngags myur du 'grub cing*/ 'bras bu rgyun chad med par 'byung ba dang*/ 'dod don la nye zhing chos kyi rgyal srid du lung ston pa dang*/ sgrib pa byang zhing chos rnams skad cig la 'chags pa'i rig 'dzin 'grub pa rnams so/ /gsang dbang gi sa chog bdun ni/ brgyud pa ldan pa'i slob dpon btsal ba dang*/ de'i yon tan brtag pa dang*/ zhu ba 'bul ba dang*/ mchod pas mnyes pa dang*/ gnang ba thob pa dang*| rtsa sbyong ba dang*/ rtsa 'khor 'gengs pa'o/ /de bdun gy-i phan yon ni/ dbang thob pa dang*/ byin rlabs 'byung ba dang*/ bar chad med pa dang*/ tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ lam du bde bar tshud pa dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ nyams myong skye ba'o/ /sta gon bzhi ni/ rig ma la gsol ba 'dab pa dang*/ de la lha bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ slob mas gsol ba 'dab pa'o// phan yon ni/ lha mos bar chad sel ba dang*/ lhas bdag gi grogs mdzad pa dang*| bde gshegs rnams dang ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'o/ /dngos gzhi drug ni/ yab yum gyi mkha' gsang dang rtsa sbyang ba dang*/ lha bstim nas rtsa khams gsal ba dang*/ sbyar thabs legs par bya ba dang*/ mkha' gsang srub pa dang*/ mig phye ba dang*/ gsung rdo rjes bde ba myong ba rnams so| |de dag gi phan yon ni/ 'khor ba sngags su bsgyur ba dang*/ /spyod pa'i don dang ldan pa dang*/ /snang ba bde ba 'char ba dang*/ /de gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*/ sngags kyis 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ snang ba ma spangs par longs skur grub nas byang sems la snang ba ston pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi sa chog bdun ni| bla ma rig ma brje ba ma gtogs snga ma bzhin te phan yon yang ngo*/ /sta gon bzhi ni/ rig ma gtad pa dang*/ gsang gnas lta ba dang*/ lhar blta ba dang*/

dga' ba bskyed pa'o/ /dngos gzhi drug ni/ mkha' gsang srub pa dang*/ dkar dmar 'phel ba dang*/ dga' bas mdangs gsal ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes dga' shar ba dang*/ de nyams su myong ba dang*/ de ngo 'phrod pa'o/ /de dag gi phan yon ma bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa'i sa chog bdun ni/ ye shes mthong ba dang*/ log pa'i dbang dgag pa dang*/ de kun tu bsgom pa dang*/ snang ba der shes pa dang*| rgyas gdab pa dang*/ de las lhag po med par rtogs pa dang*/ sa la sbyor ba'o/ /sta gon bzhi ni/ bde ba myong ba dang*/ kun rdzob lhar snang ba dang*/ don dam spros bral du shes pa dang*/ sku bzhi'i slob ma rim par brgyud pa'o/ /dngos gzhi drug ni/ gdul bya la sku so sor ston pa dang*/ gsal bar snang ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i zhing khams thob pa dang*/ 'gro ba sku bzhir bsgrub pa dang*/ gzugs sku rgyun chad med pa dang*/ chos thams cad sku bzhir gnas pa mthar thug pa rnams so/ /de ltar na slob dpon de gnyis kyis dbang bzhi ka la sa chog sta gon| thig tshon/ sgrub 'jug sogs kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa ni gzhan la ma grags shing*/ de dag gi dgos pa'am dag pa rnams ni rgyud don la nges pa khyad par can rnyed pa'i sgo chen por snang bas bris so/ /dbang rnams kyi 'bras bu'am dgos pa phreng ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pas bshad pa ni/ me tog phreng bas gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i rigs kyi nus pa 'jog pa dang*/ chu dbang gis de la sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa dang*/ cod pan gyis dbu rgyan rigs bdag gi dang*/ rdo rjes thugs dang*/ dril bus gsung dang*/ ming dbang gis mtshan gyi nus pa 'jog cing*| spang bya ma rig pa'am nyon mongs pa lnga spong*/ rig pa ye shes lnga bskyed/ bya spyod kyi rgyud 'chad pa la dbang*/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pas rgyal ba'i thugs gsung sku'i de nyid gsum dran/ chos bshad pas/ rten dkyil 'khor/ brten pa lha| slob dpon las rim gyi de nyid gsum shes/

sngags dbang gis zhi sogs 'grub cing don dam pa'i sngags kyi nus pa 'jog mig sman gyi lha'i mig 'grub/ me long gi snang ba spyi dang khyad par lhar snang la zhen pa 'gog rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung gi bya ba dngos rnams myur du 'grub/ mdor na sa bcu'i byang sems la sangs rgyas kun kyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba dang 'dra bas| phyir mi ldog pa dang slob dpon gyi dbang zhes bya zhing*/ dbang drug ka la bum chu'i bya ba dgos pas bum pa'i dbang zhes bya ste/ lus kyi sgrib pa thun mong dang thun mong min pa sbyong*/ bskyed rim 'khor bcas bsgom zhing rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ sbom po brgyad de/ dam tshig nyer gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/ dgos kyi 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul sku 'grub bo/ /gsang dbang ni/ dad pa dang shes rab kyi zhing du sgrub/ snga ma bzhin ngag gi dri ma sbyong*/ rtsa rlung las rung gi mthus sgyu lus 'grub/ nang gi dam rdzas khyad par can bsten pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje longs sku 'grub bo/ /gsum pas ni/ bzhi pa'i snod du byed/ yid sbyong*/ thugs bde chen 'od gsal gyi lam sgom pa dang*/ phyag rgya bsten pa la dbang*/ chos sku 'grub pa 'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhi'i sangs rgyas ngos zin/ 'bras bu'i zung 'jug la go ba skyes pas/ de bsgrub pa'i lam nges pa rnyed/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma phra mo sbyong*| drang nges kyi dam tshig bzhi bsten cing zung 'jug gi lam bsgom pa la dbang*| zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'grub pa rnams gsungs so/ /dbang de dag gi ngo bo ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ rig pa'i dbang lnga la ni/ bya spyod thun mong ba yin pas/ lha zhal sbyor bsgoms kyang*/ tha na 'khyud pa'i bde ba tsam yang mi bskyed cing ye shes la dbang du ngo mi sprod kyis kyang*/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la brten nas dbang rdzas gtad pa sogs kyi mthu las slob ma'i rgyud la nus pa gsar pa re skyes pa la ngo sprod pa tsam mo/

/slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ yo ga dang thun mong ba yin pas/ yum la 'khyud pa'i phyir reg la brten pa'i bde stong gi ye shes dang*/ gong ma gsum bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pas/ rtsa rlung las rung la brten pa'i nang reg dang*/ gnyis pa la phyag rgya dang dbang po'i rtsa gnyis sbyar ba'i nang reg khyad par can la brten pa'i bde stong gi ye shes la dbang du ngo sprod cing*/ smin byed bzhi pa ni/ bla ma'i gsung la brten pa'i gzhi 'bras kyi sangs rgyas ngos zin pa'i thos byung gi shes rab dbang gi ngo bo yin no// gnyis pa ni/ bla med kyi rtsa rgyud dang*/ bsdus rgyud las dkyil chog la sogs pa'i sngags kyi lag len gsungs pa ni/ dus 'khor las gsal zhing rgyas pa med la/ 'grel chen gyis shin tu'ang gsal bar mdzad mod kyi/ go rim 'khrugs pa sogs dang gzhan nas kha 'gengs dgos cung zad yod pa rnams snga phyi'i dus 'khor ba mang po 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba rnams la brgal brtags dang bcas pa'i lag len cha lag du mas brgyan te rgyas par bshad zin pas 'dir mi spro'o/ /'on kyang 'di'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa ni/ le'u 'di'i mdor bsdus dang po las rab 'byams kyi mtshan nyid dang bya ba bsdus te bstan pa las shes par bya la/ de yang gsang 'dus sgron gsal gyi le'u bcu bzhi pa'i mgor/ bshad rgyud rdor phreng drangs nas bshad pa ltar/ gsang sngags gzhan las rdo rje slob dpon gyi phrin las thams cad zhi rgyas dbang drag ste/ las chen bzhir bsdus nas las so so ba'iphyogs dang gnas dang dus dang chas gos sogs rgyas par gsungs mod kyi/ 'dir zhi rgyas gnyis/ dbang dgug gnyis te las 'jam po bzhi/ bsad bskrad gnyis/ rmongs rengs gnyis te rtsub po bzhi/ de ltar na las chen brgyad du rtsa ba las gsungs la/ 'di'i 'grel pa dang skabs gzhan gyi rtsa 'grel du/ zhi rgyas la rim gzhil ba bsnan pas zhi rgyas gzhil gsum/

dbang dgug la rim bskyod pa bsnan pas dbang dgug bskyod gsum/ bsad bskrad la dbye ba bsnan pas bsad bskrad dbye gsum/ rmongs rengs la phur gdab bsnan pas rmongs rengs gdab gsum ste| las chen bcu gnyis su lugs 'di la grags shing*/ de'i sbyin bsreg gi thig dang rtsa dang cho ga sogs kyang rgyas par spro ba'i lag len yod do/ /de ltar na 'di pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gy-i bya ba thams cad las chen bcu gnyis su dang*/ las phra mo la zhi rgyas dbang gsum la brten pa'i phan byed so gnyis/ drag las la brten pa'i gnod byed so gnyis te/ las phran drug cu rtsa bzhir grags pa rnams su bsdus shing*/ shes par byas nas dkyil 'khor cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa thams cad kyang las chen bcu gnyis po gang rung skabs dang sbyar ba'i lag len phyogs dus gnas rigs ma 'phyugs pa zhig bya dgos te/ rtsa rgyud 'bum lnga las/ rigs gzhan dang ni bya ba gzhan/ /dus dang de bzhin sngags kyi rigs/ /phyogs dang gnas dang rten gzhan gyi/ /las rnams kun la 'bras bu med/ /ces sogs dang*/ rgyud sde du mar de bzhin gsungs pa'i phyir ro// cis te rnal 'byor pa shin tu mthon por gyur te/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i bde stong gi ro la rtag tu rol par nus pa la ni nges pa med de/ 'bum lnga las/ ye shes smra ba po rnams la/ /ye shes gcig pus las kun byed/ /bzlas pa med cing bgrang phreng med/ /sbyin sreg sngags dang mchod pa med/ /bsam gtan tsam gyis las kun ni/ /rnal 'byor rnams la 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ 'di'i mchog mi 'gyur du/ kun rdzob rtog bcas rten 'brel las ma 'das pa'i rnam shes kyi bya ba nyi tshe ba dang*/ don dam rtog med rten 'brel las 'das pa'i bya ba rnams rnam pa thams cad par gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i rten 'brel ni/ kha cig 'dus byas sam dngos po tsam la byas nas/

rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs ni/ de'i rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa rgyu rkyen la brten pa dang ltos pa ma yin pa'i dngos po rig pas dpyad bzod gzhom med rtag brtan ther zug yin pas/ rten 'brel dang 'dus byas la 'khor ba'i chos kyis khyab bo zer mod kyi/ rtag pa dang dngos po gzhi mthun ni/ gtso bor mu stegs kyi 'dod pa yin la/ bden grub ni dngos por smra ba'i grub mtha' yin pas| rang lugs ni/ ma rig pas bskyed pa'i rten 'brel la dgongs kyi/ ltos grub bam rgyu rkyen tsam las byung ba'i rten 'brel ma yin no/ /des na stong gzugs mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ rgyu rkyen tsam las skyes pa dang*/ skad cig skye 'gag byed pa yin mod kyang*/ las nyon gyi rten 'brel ma yin pa dang*| rgyun gyi skye 'gag mi srid pa dang*/ lam gyis gzhom mi nus shing gzhom mi dgos kyi steng du lam stobs kyis je gsal du 'gro ba dang*/ ngo bo dri mas gos ma myong bas 'dus ma byas pa dang*/ rtag pa dang gzhom med dang zhi ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa sogs su gsungs te gzhan du yang bshad zin to/ /

lag len so sor bshad pa ni/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi sgo nas 'byor ldan la rgyas par bskur tshul/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sgo nas sems can spyi la snying rje'i dbang bskur tshul/ chos la sems pa'i sgo nas kun spangs kyi slob mal tshig gis bskur tshul lo/ / 'di la cho ga so so'i skabs kyi khyad par ngos bzung*/ de dag la gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa'o/ / dang po la/ phur gdab sa sbyang ba'i skabs su byed pa dang*/ stang stabs rang lugs kyi dbus dang*/ phyogs kyi khams dang mthun par byed pa dang*/ lhag gnas la gzhan la med pa'i rdor dril dang*/ mal stan lhag gnas byed pa dang*/ bum pa lhag gnas la dung chos chen po la rnam rgyal chen por btags te/ der dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed pa dang*/ lhag gnas kyi ye shes pa thams cad snying khar bskyed chog khyad par can las skyes pa'i dus 'khor yab yum gyi spyan 'dren pa dang*/ lhag gnas thams cad sngar bzhin sngags khyad par can gyis byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ slob ma lhag gnas la ye shes 'bebs pa lta bu'i rdor sems bskul ba dang*/ thig skud la ye thig zur pa med cing*/ gcig po de yang sum sgril slob dpon gyi mthe bong gi brgyad cha'i nas kyi tshad ky-i sbom phra can phru brgyad las ring thung mi rung ba dang*/ tshon la rtsig pa tshun la blaus byas kyi mdzes tshon mi rung ba dang*/ 'jug pa'i skabs su brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang rigs drug pa'i sdom pa bzung dgos pa dang*/ bskyed rim gyi dbang la/ sku gsung thugs kyi zhal du sgo gsum sbyong ba'i dbang gnyis gnyis dang*/ nub phyogs ye shes kyi zhal du ye shes sbyong byed rjes gnang ste dbang bdun rnams/ khams phung rlung rtsa dbang yul las bya ye shes rnams sgrub gzhir byas nas bskur ba dang*/ de'i mjug chog la thob dus go ba dang*/ bslab pa brjod pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi dbang la rgyud nyan pa la dbang bar byed pa kun rdzob drang don slob ma'i dbang bzhi dang*/

'chad pa la dbang bar byed pa don dam nges don gyi slob dpon gyi dbang bzhi de ma thag rdzogs nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i slob dpon chen por rjes su gnang ba rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang*/ khyad par nges don gyi dbang gsum pa'i skabs su dbang gi rab byed rgyas par ston pa rnams rags pa ste snga med gzhan la ma grags pa'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams blau yul du shar| de la rtog dpyod zhugs te gus pa chen po bskyed par bya ba yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ cho ga'i khyad par de dag la/ rgya bod kyi dkyil chog mkhan po rnams kyis rang dga'i 'dod tshul sna tshogs byas pa rnams phal cher ni dkyil chog pad dkar dgongs gsal du rgyas par bkag pas der blta zhing*/ dkyil chog gi yan lag rab gnas sbyin bsreg tshogs 'khor gshin chog sogs la brten pa'i log par rtog pa rnams kyang rgya mtsho bzhi la sogs pa'i stod du rnam gzhag rnams su bkag zin pas/ 'dir dbang la brten pa'i log rtog 'ga' zhig dgag par byed do/ / de la dbang bdun pa la dang*/ gong ma log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ thun mong ba'i dang*/ thal ba'i log rtog dgag pa'o/ / dang po ni/ mkhas rlom kha cigadabang bdun ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga tsam dang byed las gcig ste/ dbang bdun thob kyang rgyud nyan pa la mi dbang bar de'i ched du drang don dbang bzhi bskur dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ phyag rgya'i nu ma la reg pa'i bum dbang de la slob dpon gyi dbang du bshad pa'i phyir zhes zer ro/ /mi 'thad de/ dbang lnga thob tsam gyis ni bskyed rim gyi cha shas tsam yang bsgom pa la mi dbang la/ 'dir dbang bdun rdzogs par thob nas bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang*/ 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar gsungs shing rang gis kyang khas blangs pa'i phyir ro| |des na dbang bdun rdzogs par thob pas bla med kyi dang*/

khyad par rgyud 'di yang bskyed rim dang 'brel pa drang don gyi bshad pa mtha' dag nyan pa dang*/ sgom pa la dbang mod kyi rdzogs rim ston pa don dam nges don gyi bshad pa zhib tu nyan pa la mi dbang bas de'i ched du drang don dbang bzhi bskur ba yin la/ 'di dbang bdun la chu dbang zhes pa ma gtogs bum dbang gi dngos su ma gsungs kyang bum pa'i chu'i bya ba yod pas bum dbang gi sgra bshad dang phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang gi don legs par tshang bas rgyud sde gzhan dang sgo bstun gyi slob dpon gyi dbang yang rdzogs par yod mod kyi/ bskyed rdzogs kyi dbang mtha' dag slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang*/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no zhes bzhir bsdus pa'i tshe/ 'di pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bum dbang yang slob dpon gyi dbang du sdud dgos pas de ltar gsungs kyi/ dbang bdun la/ slob dpon gyi dbang med pa ni ma yin te/ rigs drug ka'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i rjes gnang 'dogs dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ gzhan dag ni/ 'di'i dbang bdun la rdzogs rim gyi dbang yang tshang ste/ rlung bcu dang rtsa ro rkyang la sogs pa'i sgrub gzhir byas pa'i bskyed chog khyad par yod pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro/ /'di ni gsang 'dus lta bu'i pha rgyud rkyang pa'i dngos bstan la 'khrul nas/ rtsa rlung thig le'i sgom rim khyad par can yod na rdzogs rim yin no zhes pa'i grub mtha' gsar du bcas pa'i skyon yin te/ de lta na bde mchog gi lus dkyil la sogs pa rdzogs rim du thal ba'i phyir dang*/ khyad par dbu ma'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su dmigs pa gtad nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor la rdzogs rim gyis khyab pa'ang*/ de'i gtso bo yab yum gyi rnal 'byor gyis gshig pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na bla med gzhir byas pa'ang pha dang ma gnyis med kyi dngos bstan la sgom rim zab rgyas kyi khyad par yod par shes na log rtog rang zhi la 'gro bar shes par bya'o/

/ gnyis pa ni/ dpal jo nang pa na re/ rdzogs rim gyi dbang gsum yin te/ dbang bskur dngos dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang*/ bdag po chen po'i dbang ngo*/ /mtshan gzhi ni rim pa bzhin drang don dbang bzhi dang*/ rjes gnang chen po dang*/ nges don dbang bzhi rnams yin la go rim kyang de bzhin du bskur bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /'di ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ drang don dbang bzhi bskur nas rgyud kyi nges don thams cad kyang nyan/ rdzogs rim kyang legs par bsgom/ myong ba ci rigs pa skye zhing rgyud don legs par khong du chud pa na tshogs 'khor mtshan nyid tshang ba dang bcas te/ nges don dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ rgyud thams cad shes shing ston pa por gyur pa'i tshe na dkyil 'khor dang khrus stegs legs par bris nas/ ston pa po'i dbang ngam rjes gnang chen po sbyin pa ni rigs pas legs par thob cing*/ da ni bdag gis rgyud thams cad shes so zhes gsol gdab gyi tshig la sogs pa'i lung rnams kyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du sngon dang da lta'i dus 'khor nges don la gtso bor bshad sgrub byed pa por rlom pa mang po phyi dkyil du dbang bskur cung zad kyang ma thob/ bskyed rim gy-i lha grangs tsam yang mi shes pa'i skya ser pho mo mang po bsdus te/ dbang gong ma'i cho ga tshang ma tshang ci rigs pa re byas nas/ dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug pa rdzogs par 'bogs shing*/ snang ba za zi chos skur ngo sprod pa sogs kyi sgo nas dpon slob thams cad sa mtshams shin tu mtho sar sleb pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed do/ /'di dag ni spyir bstan pa'i 'jug rim dang*/ sgos rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug sgo dbang gi rnam gzhag la rmongs shing*/ tshogs lam chung ngu yang rgyud la ma skyes bzhin du mthong lam skyes par 'dod pa'i gti mug dang 'dun pas 'gro ba yin pas/ rgyud don shes pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu smad par 'os pa yin no/

/'on kyang dal 'byor dang ldan pa'i gang zag dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i mtshan tsam gyis tshim zhing thabs gzhan gyis 'dul du mi rung ba dag la ni longs spyod la snying po blang ba'i phyir du tshogs sog sgo du ma nas byed du bcug ste/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs tsam phog lam gyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs| yig brgya maṇ+ḍal sogs kyis rgyud legs par sbyong du bcug nas sems gnas sna re tsam sgom du bcug pa'i thabs mkhas ni bkag pa med pas/ sngon gyi mkhas pa dag kyang mdzad mod kyi/ de la ni dbang gong ma bskur don med do/ /'o na lugs 'di'i dbang gi ngo bo dang dbye bsdu dang khyad par ji lta bu yin zhe na/ dbang bdun phal cher ni sngar bshad pa ltar nus pa gsar pa nyid yin la/ rjes gnang gi 'dogs kyi gtso bo dam tshig gsum gyi phyag rgya'i dam tshig 'khrud pa'i de stong sbrail nas phyi reg gi bde stong nyid rgyud sde gzhan dang thun mong ba'i slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo y-in no/ /gong ma la drang don dbang bzhi dang nges don gyi dbang dang po gsum ste bdun ni 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin pas dbang dus kyi bde ba ma zad/ de dag gi lam dngos rnams kyang so so'i skye bo'i lam las ma 'das so/ /de yang dang po gsum la drang nges kyi khyad par ni/ rdzogs rim sgom pa sngon du ma song ba dang song ba'i khyad kyis rig ma re re'i nu ma la reg pa dang*/ gsang rdzas rdzas myang zhing gsang gnas bltas pa dang*/ tshogs 'khor gyi spyod pa khyad par can dang ma 'brel ba'i gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba tsam dang*/ rig ma lo bcu ma nas nyi shu'i bar du bcu tshang ba la reg pa dang*/ 'khyud pa dang gsang rdzas myang ba sogs kyi bde ba yin pas bde ba dman mchog dang*/ des stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag rgyun thung ba dang ring ba nyid yin la/ bzhi pa gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ dbang gsum pa'i mtha'i yas babs tha ma'i skad cig ni drang don bzhi pa ste/

'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i mas brten dang po 'gyur med bde ba'i skad cig dang po nas nges don bzhi pa dngos su 'jog pas/ sm-in byed tshig dbang ni de dag gi don spyi legs par shar ba'i go ba'am thos bsam gyi shes rab nyid do/ de ltar na 'di pa'i dbang la rgyas par dbye na/ byis pa ltar 'jug pa bskyed rim dbang bdun dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhi tshan gnyis te bco lnga yang dbyer mod kyi/ drang nges kyi dang po gsum gsum/ bum gsang shes rab ye shes zhes gsum du bsdu zhing*/ drang don bzhi pa'am nges don gsum pa las rdzas log tu med pas der bsdus nas rdzogs rim la 'jig rten pa'i dbang gsum dang*/ dbang gong ma'i gong ma nges don bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gcig ste bcu gcig tu gsungs la| rtsa rgyud las/ dang por dbang bskur bdun po gang*/ /byis pa rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir/ /rnam gsum 'jig rten kun rdzob kyis/ /dam pa'i don ni bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ 'grel chen du/ dbang bskur ba 'jig rten pa'i bcu dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcu gcig pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bsdu na/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang ngam lam gyi rgyu'i dbang dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang ngam lam dngos 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbang zhes gnyis su bsdus te/ ye ler/ de dag thams cad nges par 'jig rten pa ste mchog gi snying rje yis ni lam gyi rgyu ru bstan/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang gang mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phyag rgya mchog la rjes su sbyor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar dbang re re yang smin byed rgyu dang*/ grol byed lam dang*/ thob bya don dam 'bras bu'i dbang gsum gsum du dbyer yod de| dbang bdun la nus pa khyad par can bzhi 'khyud pa'i bde stong dang bcas pa'i dang po dang*/ rgyal mchog gnyis dang*/ rnal 'byor gnyis ni gnyis pa dang*/

sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i spang rtogs rdzogs pa ni gsum pa'o/ /gong ma'i 'jig rten pa gsum la/ dbang dus kyi bde ba dngos sam rjes mthun pa gsum ni dang po dang*/ sor bsam dang*/ srog 'dzin dang*/ rjes dran rnams ni gnyis pa dang*/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu pa legs pa'i blau gros sam/ rgyal bu gzhon nu/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi spangs rtogs rdzogs pa ni gsum pa'o/ /bzhi pa la yang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen stong gzugs la 'khyud pa gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ka la yod par nges pa'i shes rab ni dang po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ni gnyis pa/ sa bcu gnyis pa chos ky-i dbang phyug sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi mthar thug pa ni gsum pa'o/ /zhes blo gros can gyis shes par bya'o/ /'o na mas brten dang po 'gyur med bde ba'i skad cig dang po ni nges don bzhi par 'jog na/ bzhi pa sku thugs zung 'jug la 'jog pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ 'gyur med kyi bde chen gyi thugs tsam yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ ma grub ste/ 'gyur med bde chen du skyes pa nyid kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnam ldan du legs par grub pas thugs su grub par ma zad/ rgyu stong gzugs mtshan nyid tshang ba ma grub bar du 'gyur med du skye mi srid pas 'gyur med bde chen gyi don spyi legs par shar na stong gzugs dang zhal sbyor du mi 'char ba'i thabs med pa'i phyir dang*/ ye ler/ shes rab ye shes dag kyang sems dang de yi snang ba dag gi rnam pa bcu po nyid du 'gyur/ /dbang ni dri med ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan lta bu 'di la zhugs pa gang yin pa// de las mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba 'pho med lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med nyid ni bzhi pa ste/ /zhes dang*/ mchog gi bde ba gzhom du med pa ye shes sku/ /zhes dang*| dam pa'i bde ba bsgrubs nas lhan cig skyes pa rgyal ba'i sku ni kun tu 'gro ba bsgrub par bya/

zhes dang*/ dbang mdor bstan du/ stong pa gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa rgyu/ /snying rje 'gyur med 'dzin pa 'bras/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ /byang chub sems de mi 'pho ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas btab cing*/ /'bras bu rgyu yis rgyas btab bo/ /gzugs kyis srid par mi 'ong ste/ /'gyur med mya ngan 'das mi 'gro/ /phan tshun 'khyud pa zhi ba ste| |ma ning gi ni go 'phang mchog /ces sogs bde chen gang bshad du ye shes kyi sku yang rgya cher gsungs la/ rje btsun tsong kha pas sngags rim du/ gsang sngags gzhan gyi bde stong dang dus 'khor ba'i bde stong mi gcig ste/ gzhan gyi ni yul can bde ba chen pos yul stong nyid rtogs pa'i thugs tsam la bde stong zhes zer la/ dus 'khor ba'i bde ba ni/ thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen dang stong pa ni stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo gnyis tshogs la bde stong du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes lan mang du gsungs pa yang don 'di legs par dgongs pa'i legs bshad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dbang bzhi pa rgyud 'dir gsal bar gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud gzhan du sbas nas ma gsungs pa yang mngon sum du grub pa yin te/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma dang*/ sam+bu ṭi la sogs par gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes bskur tshul rgyas par gsungs nas bzhi pa la/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes rkang pa re re las ma gsungs par sbas shing*/ brtag gnyis cung zad rgyas kyang*/ bde ba gnag dang bde ba ser/ /zhes sogs bde ba'i rten thig le la bde bar bshad pa sogs kyis sgo nas sbas la/ lam la yang 'dus pa phyi ma dang gur brtag tu dbye ba ngos 'dzin gsal gsal 'dra yang*| spyi dang khyad par du ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag mi gsal/ sems 'grel mnyam po la yang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u dang por sbyor drug gi gsum dngos su dang*/ gsum shugs la bstan par mdzad de legs par bkral yang*/

ting nge 'dzin gsal por ma gsungs pa sogs kyis cung zad lhag ma dang bcas la/ bzhi pa'i dbang lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa shin tu gsal zhing rgyas pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo kho na yin te/ rdo rje bzhi pa'i rgyud dang*/ bden don bcu gnyis pa dang*/ de kho na nyid bcu drug pa dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo dga' ba bzhi'am bcu drug pa/ rigs drug pa gtso bo rgyal ba'i bdag po nyid bstan bya'i gtso bor mdzad pa lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pas kyang 'grub ste/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi lam gyi mthar thug bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa dang*| slob ma'i zung 'jug gi bde stong yang spyod pa gsum la brten pa'i 'gyur bde dang g.yo bde kho nar gsungs shing*/ 'gyur bdes ni spang bya'i sa bon rdzogs par spong bar mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud 'di nyid kyi yang dbang ler dbang bzhi pa rgyas par ma gsungs par ye le la zhal 'phangs shing*/ de'i mdor bsdus gnyis pa'i 'jug dang*/ gsum pa mchog mi 'gyur du log rtog rgyas par bkag pa'i sgo nas rgya cher gsungs te/ rdzogs rim gyi ngo sprod du rgyas par 'chad pas 'dir mi spro'o/ /lnga pa dbang de ltar bskur ba'i dgos pa ni/ spyir bskyed rim gyi dbang gis sdig sgrib gnyis su phye ba'i sdig pa'i dri ma sbyong zhing*| de yang sgo gsum ye shes dang bcas pa'i dṛ ma rags pa phar phyin theg pa nas bshad pa dang*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa sngags lam gyi 'gyur bde'i dri ma rags pa yang sbyong ba'i nus pa thob nas bskyed rim bsnyen sgrub bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi mthar phyin pa na/ phar phyin theg pa'i sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs shing*/ sngags lam gyi tshogs lam chung ngu mthar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /'di la kha cigabaskyed rim thar lam dang mchog bsgrub pa'i lam ma yin par 'dod pa ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs ma yin par thal ba dang*/

rgyud kyi nying dgos dang 'brel ba'i dgos pa ma yin par thal ba la sogs pa'i gnod byed mang po mkhas pa dag gis gsungs shing*/ kho bos kyang dus 'khor gyi bskyed rim chen mor brjod zin to/ /yang kha cigagasang 'dus rim lngar/ dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sa brgyad pa ni thob par 'gyur| |snang ba gsum po thob pa yis/ /sa bcu pa la rab tu gnas/ /zhes sogs bskyed rim la las dang po pa'i lam du gsungs shing*/ de ni phar phyin theg par tshogs lam la bshad pas/ sngags kyi tshogs lam la bskyed rim gyis khyab cing rdzogs rim gyi mtha' sbyor lam drod nas 'jog dgos so zhes zer ro| |ma khyab ste/ rim lnga'i lus dben dang sbyor drug gi sor bsam la las dang po pa'i lam dang*/ sor bsam gyi rnal 'byor pa la las dang po pa'i gang zag du lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i theg chen tshogs lam chen po nas rgyun ting nge 'dzin thob pa bzhin du sngags lam gyi yang tshogs lam chen po nas sngags lam rang gi mngon shes thob dgos shing*/ de ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag mthar ma phyin gyi bar du mi thob pas bskyed rim pa la yong don med pa'i phyir ro/ bskyed rim mthar phyin pa nas sa bdun pa'i spangs rtogs 'grub pa dang mi 'gal te/ de la phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong gi mngon shes drug ka yod kyang*/ sngags lam gyi dbang shes phyi ma gsum la brten pa'i mngon shes 'ong don med pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzogs rim gyi dbang bzhis ni sgrib pa'i dri ma sbyong zhing de yang sgo gsum ye shes dang bcas pa'i dri ma thun mong ba phra mo dang sngags lam gyi thun mong ma yin pa phra rags thams cad rim pa bzhin sbyong la/ bum dbang dang de'i lam sor bsam mthar phyin pas sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang*/ gsang ba dang srog 'dzin mthar phyin pas sa dgu pa legs pa'i blau gros dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang rjes dran mthar phyin pas bcu pa chos kyi sprin dang*/

bzhi pa dang ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pas sangs rgyas kyi sa la kun tu 'od dang zla ba'i 'od la sogs pa sa bcu gnyis su phye ba'i spangs rtogs rdzogs par 'gyur la/ sngags lam gyi ni/ sor bsam 'bring mchog srog 'dzin sbyor lam thog ma/ rjes dran skad cig tha ma/ ting nge 'dzin skad cig dang po nas mthong lam/ bu ston gyi gsungs mkhas pa byang mchog gi zin bris las/ rdo rje nor bur mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skad cig thob nas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skad cig kyang stong brgyad brgyad ma rdzogs kyi bar la 'jig rten chos mchogastong brgyad brgyad rdzogs pa sa dang po/ byang sems kyi phyed gang*/ de nas byang sems kha gyen du bltas te yar 'phel nas sum stong drug brgya rdzogs pa dang sa gnyis pa/ byang sems gsang gnas su brtan/ de nas lte bar sum stong drug brgyas sa bzhi/ de nas snying khar sum stong drug brgyas sa drug de nas mgrin par sum stong drug brgyas sa brgyad/ de nas dpral bar sum stong drug brgyas sa bcu| gtsug tor du sum stong drug brgyas sa bcu gnyis thob nas sangs rgyas pa yin gsungs/ de dang bcas pa'i stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig gis sa dang po kun tu 'od dang*/ de nas gcig gis sa gnyis pa mthar phyin zhing*/ byang sems nor bu nas gyen du log ste gsang gnas kyi bar du bstan/ de bzhin du mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen stong brgyad brgya phrag gnyis kyis sa gnyis gnyis rdzogs shing*| lte ba dang*/ snying kha dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ gtsug tor gyi bar du bsten te/ bem chos sam/ 'pho ba'i bag chags phra ba'i sa bon stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis spangs te/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa las grol ba'i sa bcu gnyis mthar phyin pa'i mthar thug gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das theg pa mtha' dag dang lam mtha' dag la bltos pa'i spang bya thams cad spangs shing yon tan yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/

smin grol gyi dbang mtha' dag rdzogs par thob pa'i dgongs pa'i 'bras bu yin no| |'di la sngaun dang da lta'i dus 'khor ba thams cad mgrin gcig tu/ bde chen stong brgyad brgya pa phrag dang po sbyor lam du 'jog pa ni/ so skye'i lam na spang bya'i sa bon spong ba'i dngos gnyen yod pa'am/ yang na spang bya'i sa bon stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig ma spangs pa'i mthar thug gi sangs rgyas yod pa gang rung du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /gnyis pa grol byed lam la kun rdzob drang don rgya chen gtso bor gyur pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ don dam nges don zab pa gtso bor gyur pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de gnyis so so'i ngo bo'am mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin/ sngags lam gyi gtso bo gang zhig snang phyogs sngags kyi sku la dmigs pa'i mos pa yid byed rjes dpag rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ gang zhig stong phyogs ye shes kyi sku la dmigs pa'i de kho na nyid yid byed mngon sum rtog med ma 'khrul ba'i rnam 'byor te/ lha yi dmigs pa dag kyang mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// mngon sum min na rjes su dpag pa shi ba'i lus bzhin de nyid min pa yis ni brtags pa gang*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ de'i 'grel pa dri med 'od dang*/ sems 'grel gzhan gnyis las kyang*/ bskyed rim rtog sgom dang*/ rdzogs rim rtog med ma 'khrul bar lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang dngos sam gtso bo'i dbang du byas shing*/ 'khor ram phal pa'i dbang du byas na bskyed rim gyi sbyor 'jug rtog med dang rdzogs rim gyi sbyor 'jug rtog bcas yod de/ bskyed rim pas gzugs mdzes mthong nas bde stong sbyor ba na/ mig shes rtog med bde stong ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes pa'am/

ma skyes kyang dbang shes 'khor gyi bde ba stong nyid rnam ldan du 'char ba srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na des stong nyid mngon sum rtogs par 'gyur la 'dod na 'phags par thal lo/ /zhe na| khyad par cha shas rnam g.yeng dang*/ /mngon sum gyis ni bzung ba la/ khyad par gang la rtog pa yi/ /skyon yod de ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis mthong yang ma rtogs pa du ma srid pas skyon med la/ theg pa gzhan gyi 'phags par thal ba ni 'dod pa'i skabs kyang srid do/ /de bzhin du rdzogs rim gyi sbyor ba nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems kyis stong nyid sgom pa dang*/ rtsa dang rlung la dmigs pa'i zhen rig du ma rdzogs rim gyis sbyor 'jug tu 'byung ba yin no/ /de dag bskyed rdzogs dngos ma yin yang cha mthun pa'i sgo nas de'i phyogs su bsdu'o// de ltar na rim gnyis re re la yang bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen ste bzhi bzhi tshang la/ de la lus dbyibs kyi dang*/ ngag sngags kyi dang*/ sems chos kyi dang*/ ye shes dag pa'i rnal 'byor te/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ming gis gsungs shing*| sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rnam pa lnga'i dang*/ rnam pa nyi shu dang*/ skad cig ma gcig dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa ste/ mngon byang bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes kyang gsungs pa rnams tshang zhing rdzogs par dgos te/ thob bya'am sbyangs 'bras la sku bzhi/ rdo rje bzhi/ byang chub bzhi/ mkhyen pa bzhi rnams la/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan dang*/ nyin mor byed pa'i sku dang*/ ye shes kyi sku dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyis gsungs pa'i bzhi tshan tshang bar bzhugs pa bzhin du lam dus nas legs par sgrub dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ sbyang bya rags pa gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa dang*/ phra ba kun gzhi rnam shes la gnas skabs bzhi bskyed pa 'gyur bde'i nus pa bzhi yod pa sbyang dgos pa'i phyir dang*/

sbyang gzhi sku bzhi ye shes su gsungs shing*| mkha' khyab nam mkha'i rdo rje can dang*/ gtso bo srid pa gsum gyis btud cing gzhom med kun tu 'gro ba gang*/ zhes dang*/ thub pa med pa dpe med pa| |mi mngon mi snang gsal byed min/ /mi 'gyur kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /phra zhing zag med sa bon no/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes sogs kyis dngos su bstan cing*/ kyai rdo rjer/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'gro kun lhan cig skyes par nyid| |rang bzhin lhan gcig skyes pa brjod/ sogs dang*/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan no/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*/ 'dus pa lugs gnyis sogs su/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems/ rnal 'byor rgyud du yang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /zhes sogs/ mdo sogs 'khor lo tha mar/ zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /zhes sogs kyis bde gshegs snying po gsungs pa'i tha snyad gnas lugs bzhi'i sangs rgyas su bzhag pa de'i steng du 'gyur med kyi thig le bzhi po ngo bo gcig tu bzhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rim pa gnyis las bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag spyi sgos dwogs gcod dang bcas pa ni rgyas par zur du bshad zin cing*/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa ni khrid ma thob pa rnams la bstan du mi rung bas zur du 'chad pa las shes dgos pas 'dir mi 'chad la/ 'dir ni rim gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum la log rtog chen po dag dgag pa skabs su bab pas 'di ltar dgag par bya ste/

gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu la log rtog dgag pa'o/ / dang po la tha snyad pa'i gnas lugs la skur pa btab nas sangs rgyas phyi nas btsal dgos pa'i log rtog dgag pa dang*/ don dam pa'i gnas lugs la skur pa btab nas sangs rgyas nang na rdzogs par grub zin pa'i log rtog dgag pa'o/ / dang po la spyir dgag pa dang*/ bye brag sangs rgyas gzhan la sgrub gzhi yod kyang*/ dus 'khor ba la sgrub gzhi med pa'i log rtog dgag pa'o/ / dang po ni/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan tsam la 'dris par byas shing zhen nas zab gsal gnyis las gsal ba'i cha la skal ba zhan pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po dag na re/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba ma yin dgag tu gyur pa'i dngos po'i chos yongs gcod du grub pa ni gtan med de| yod na brtag dngos dang*/ bden grub dang*/ rigs pas dpyad bzod du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ des na snying po mdo bcu la sogs par de 'dra yod pa ltar gsungs pa rnams ni/ sems kyi chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa la dgongs nas/ sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa la sogs pa'i skyon lnga spang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i drang don dgongs pa can kho na yin no zhes zer ro| |'di dag ni/ lung don rig pas gtan la dbab dgos pas lung gis mi tshim mo zhes rigs pa la gtso bo byed pa por snang bas/ thog mar gnod byed kyi rigs pa brjod par bya ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa phun tshogs de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs 'dra khyad par can zhig gzhi dus na yod par thal| rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spangs pa de'i thun mong ma yin pa de'i rigs 'dra khyad par can zhig gzhi dus na yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gsal gnyis ka dngos 'gal yin la/ khyab pa la mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan rigs pa shes shing gzu bor gnas pa ni sus kyang brjod pa mi nus la/ mi shes pa'i rdol thabs smra ba dang*/ shes kyang 'du shes bsgyur ba'i bsnyon tshig smra ba ni bstan pa la 'tshe bar zad do/

/gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sa bon nam/ nyer len phyi nas btsal dgos par 'gyur te/ sems can gyi rgyud la gzhi dus na sangs rgyas kyi sgrub gzhi dang dngos por gyur pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mdo sngags kyi lung du mas gnod par ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi sa bon 'debs pa po su zhig gis byed cing*| 'tshol ba po dag gis gang nas 'tshol blo nang du khug la legs par soms shig rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid yod pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi nyer len yod par 'dod na/ snod kyi 'jig rten la yang yod par thal ba bzlog tu med do/ /gzhan yang 'dod pa 'di ni/ snying po mdo bcu pa la sogs pa'i bka' 'khor lo tha ma mtha' dag dang*/ rgyud sde gong 'ogakhyad par sems 'grel gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams kyi dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bo las rgyab kyis phyogs par ma zad/ 'khor lo bar pa nyid kyi dngos bstan la yang skur ba 'debs pa yin te/ sems la sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing*| yul stong nyid don dam pa'i bden pa la ni 'od gsal gyi don ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad 'khor lo dang po'i dngos bstan gyis kyang gnod de/ 'dul bar rtogs pa tshul khrims yang dag gi mdor/ dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ srog ni chad/ tshe'i 'du byed ni nges par 'dor bar 'gyur na zhes gsungs la/ de ltar na/ 'chi srid mngon du gyur pa na/ rnam smin skyes kyi srog dbang dang tshe'i 'du byed rgyun chad pa bzhin du/ 'chi srid dang*/ brgyal ba dang*/ gnyid 'thug pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug gnyis la sogs pa sems med du bshad pa rnams kyi tshe rig rgyun chad par 'dod dgos pa las/ shes pa 'grib ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ chos rjes dran gyi mdor/ rten yod pa rgyu ba chad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa/ 'khor 'das kyi rten/
